card.name: Start of hydrochloride after drug name
card.fires_on: The point right after a drug name where "hydrochloride" is about to be written, often the H of HCl or the hydro of dihydrochloride. It also fires on the end of a drug name just before a salt form.

modes.label: H of HCl
modes.description: The letter H after a drug name, starting the abbreviation HCl.
modes.example: Epinastine<< H>>Cl should not be used to treat contact

modes.label: hydro of hydrochloride
modes.description: The hydro piece inside dihydrochloride or hydrochloride after a drug name.
modes.example: Pramipexole di<<hydro>>chloride extended-release tablets must be swallowed

card.writes: It promotes hydro and HCl pieces, pushing the model to continue with a hydrochloride salt name.
card.plain: It spots a drug name that is about to be followed by its hydrochloride salt label.
